abstract: Two patients with advanced germ cell tumor who entered complete remission following intensive combination chemotherapy, radiation therapy and surgical intervention are reported. A 28-year-old businessman presented with abdominal pain and masses associated with an elevated HCG level for which he underwent exploratory laparotomy. Large retroperitoneal masses were found and microscopical examination of the masses were revealed seminoma. Three courses of combination chemotherapy consisting of CDDP, VLB and PEP were given to the patient followed by radiation therapy to the parailiac, paraaortic, mediastinal and supraclavicular lymph nodes with boost irradiation to the paraaortic lymph nodes where the large masses were located. The other patient was a 21-year-old student who developed sharp precordial chest pain which proved to be due to a large mediastinal mass accompanied by an elevated AFP level. He was treated with radiation therapy to the mediastinum, surgical resection and combination chemotherapy. However, he showed recurrence in the lungs associated with rising AFP levels, and was given a salvage chemotherapy consisting of 3 courses of CDDP, ADR, PEP and Etoposide. Both patients were successfully treated with combined modalities of treatment including intensive chemotherapy and have been off therapy without recurrence for over 12 and 4 months, respectively.
abstract_ja: 進行した胚細胞腫瘍の2例が、集学的な積極的治療により完全寛解に至った。1例目は28歳の男性で、腹痛と腫瘤を呈し、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値が上昇していた。開腹探索術を行い、後腹膜に大きな腫瘤が認められ、組織学的検査でセミノーマであった。CDDP、VLB、PEPによる化学療法を3コース実施した後、傍腸骨、傍大動脈、縦隔、鎖骨上リンパ節に放射線療法を行い、大きな腫瘤のある傍大動脈リンパ節には追加照射を行った。2例目は21歳の学生で、前胸部痛を呈し、縦隔に大きな腫瘤があり、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値が上昇していた。縦隔への放射線療法、外科的切除、化学療法の併用治療を受けたが、肺に再発し、AFP値も上昇した。そのため、CDDP、ADR、PEP、エトポシドによる救援化学療法を3コース行った。両症例とも、強力な化学療法を含む集学的治療により治療に成功し、それぞれ12か月以上、4か月以上再発なく経過している。
